title: Stage feature and architecture ablations after the base recipe
doing: Keep separate single-change proposals for closing/relative velocity, clearance rays, action history, pooled heads, D4 augmentation and extra attention depth, each against a matched base with two training seeds. expected: Some geometric or history features may help cul-de-sac avoidance, while pooling or depth may improve encoding. Extra capacity, changed warm starts or imperfect symmetry can instead harm; each effect remains unobserved.
